name: vault.runs.program_hold.release
description: The owner releases one held turn program's try against the exact hold he read: stop ends it and clears the hold, its run kept; resume queues the same try once its checkpoint, authority, pin and effects check out.
call: memory.with_owner_or_delegate("vault.runs.program_hold.release", |who, credential| match who { crate::authority::OwnerOrDelegate::Owner(owner) => crate::dreamer_runner::release_turn_program_hold_as_owner(memory.vault(), owner, &input).map_err(crate::memory::MemoryError::from), crate::authority::OwnerOrDelegate::Delegate(agent) => crate::dreamer_runner::release_turn_program_hold_as_delegate(memory.vault(), agent, credential, &input) })?
